archetypes.name: dyn-crash-provenance
archetypes.rationale: Crash recovery now distinguishes salvage commits from unsafe repository drift.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the crashed-lane finalizer's HEAD, worktree, and salvage-commit provenance checks. Verify every ambiguous state fails closed and that reship cannot consume another tier. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
